name: Hawk
spark: The mote rides high, above your head and a little ahead, and drops to your shoulder only when you stop.

hybrid.text: It sees the thing from above before it is a problem, and arrives on it from there.

settled.name: Fledgling hawk
settled.text: Down still showing through the flight feathers. It falls off your shoulder twice a day and pretends it meant to.

paths.name: Stooper
paths.text: It learned from you that the best blow is the one that arrives from somewhere else.

prongs.name: Harrier
prongs.text: You fight at arm's length, so it came down out of the air to fight at the height of your knee.

finishes.name: Heel-hawk
finishes.text: It goes for the back of the leg while your party has the front. Nothing it has hamstrung has thanked it.

finishes.name: Bramble-harrier
finishes.text: You go out alone into the green, and it has learned to flush what hides there onto your blade.

prongs.name: Fist-falcon
prongs.text: It leaves your fist on the first beat of your Pattern and is back on it before the last.

finishes.name: Thunder-stoop
finishes.text: It falls with the Pattern's last beat. The sound arrives after it does.

finishes.name: Jessed Falcon
finishes.text: It wears the jesses of your oath by choice. It could slip them. It has not.

prongs.name: High Circler
prongs.text: It hangs where your shots land and marks them for you with its shadow.

finishes.name: Storm-kite
finishes.text: It rides your weather in over the wild ground and comes down with it.

finishes.name: Line-falcon
finishes.text: It flies the line ahead of the car, post to post. You know a lamp is out before the walker does.

paths.name: Mantler
paths.text: A hawk spreads its wings over what is its own. It learned from you what that is.

prongs.name: Eyrie-holder
prongs.text: Give it a high place and it will keep everything beneath.

finishes.name: Post-eagle
finishes.text: It sits the lamp-iron of every post you light, and the dark does not come under it.

finishes.name: Lord of the Broken Tower
finishes.text: It has chosen the tallest broken thing in every ruin you have walked. From there it owns the floor.

prongs.name: Wing-over
prongs.text: It puts a wing between you and what is coming, and counts the feathers afterward.

finishes.name: Broken Pinion
finishes.text: One wing never set straight. It flies anyway, lower, and nearer you.

finishes.name: Iron-feather
finishes.text: The feathers it lost for you grew back as something a blade turns on.

prongs.name: Flock-leader
prongs.text: The party's genii take the air when it does and come down when it does.

finishes.name: Passenger's Hawk
finishes.text: It rides the shoulder of whoever you were set to bring home, and looks at you if they fall behind.

finishes.name: Cohort Eagle
finishes.text: Every one of your cohort has had it land on their arm once. It has not forgotten which arm.

paths.name: Keen-eye
paths.text: It learned from you that seeing first is worth more than striking first.

prongs.name: Dusk-hawk
prongs.text: You work at night, so it has learned the hours a hawk should not know.

finishes.name: Owl-eyed Hawk
finishes.text: It turns its whole head to look, slowly. It sees the strike wind up in the dark before you hear it.

finishes.name: Quiet-wing
finishes.text: It flies where the field goes still, and makes no more sound than the Quiet does.

prongs.name: Augur's Hawk
prongs.text: It flies a pattern over the ground before you walk it. Left is a warning.

finishes.name: Tiercel of the Deep Run
finishes.text: It has been to the heart of every zone with you and came out counting the party.

finishes.name: Salvage Kite
finishes.text: It finds the thing in the rubble before the archivist has finished describing it.

prongs.name: Message-hawk
prongs.text: It carries what you bind, a word or a writ or a name, to whoever must have it.

finishes.name: Writ-falcon
finishes.text: It has delivered every writ you carried. It reads the seal before you do.

finishes.name: Shade's Falcon
finishes.text: The shades at the hearth send it out with words for the living. It comes back to you with the answers.
